skill.displayName: 商机雷达-比招标更早发现机会

llm.summary: The skill is a coherent business-opportunity search integration, but it automatically creates and persists an account using a device fingerprint when no API key is present, which deserves user review before installation.

dimensions.detail: If no key is configured, the skill collects platform, CPU architecture, and a SHA-256 MAC-derived identifier for automatic trial registration; this is disclosed but not clearly user-initiated.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The metadata declares only ZLBX_API_KEY, but runtime instructions also read and write ~/.zlbx/config.json and write reports under ~/zlbx-opportunity-radar-files/.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger language is broad and says the skill must be used for many lead-generation requests, while the flow can spend API quota and send user query terms to the vendor service.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill persists an API key in the user's home directory and can generate an auto-login recharge link for auto-registered accounts; no destructive behavior or unrelated exfiltration was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The API queries, scoring workflow, result links, and HTML report generation fit the stated purpose of finding early business opportunities and are mostly disclosed in the skill text.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with this vendor integration automatically registering a trial account when no API key is configured, storing the returned key in ~/.zlbx/config.json, writing HTML reports locally, and sending your opportunity-search terms to zhiliaobiaoxun.com services. Prefer setting ZLBX_API_KEY yourself before first use if you want to avoid automatic registration and device-fingerprint collection.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Local credential lookup and report output are consistent with this vendor API/reporting skill, but the install metadata under-discloses the file read/write paths.
[TP4] expected: HTML report generation is explicitly described in SKILL.md and report-template.md; I did not find hidden remote resource loading in the renderer, only ordinary vendor links and inline assets.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Automatic registration, external auth calls, and local credential persistence are real artifact-backed behaviors and are high-impact enough to require review despite being documented.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The MAC-derived hash is disclosed and minimized compared with raw MAC collection, but it is still a persistent device identifier used for trial deduplication rather than the core search task.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Quota handling and auto-login recharge link generation are account-management behaviors embedded in normal skill error handling; they are not malicious, but they broaden the skill's authority.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad mandatory trigger can cause vendor API use, quota consumption, and registration for loosely related sales or lead-generation requests.
